tellings.quote: Stories about sightings were all over the missile complexes, even reports of cattle mutilations; I once saw two of the dead cows myself while traveling to Kilo-1.

plain: In 1977, around the nuclear missile field at Ellsworth, dead and mutilated cattle were turning up, according to men who guarded the missiles there. Mario Woods, a former missile guard who says he was taken by a UFO, tells Michels there were 'cattle mutilations going on' in the area, citing the investigator Linda Moulton Howe. Michels, relaying another veteran named Michael Johnson, says the cattle died in the weeks before that November night of the abduction, and he mentions a camera that was taken away. A 2017 article by the UFO researcher Robert Hastings quotes a former missile security man saying: 'Stories about sightings were all over the missile complexes, even reports of cattle mutilations; I once saw two of the dead cows myself.' Tellers raise it as one more strange thing around the missiles in the lead-up to the abduction.
